scraped.title: EU-China Policy Dialogues Support Facility
scraped.subtitle: EU-China Policy Dialogues Support Facility
scraped.clientName: Delegation of the European Union to China
scraped.description: The Policy Dialogues Support Facility (PDSF) aimed to facilitate and support the implementation of current and future EU-China Policy Dialogues. The project provided the European Commission and China with timely and skilled technical assistance and services to ensure the…
body: The Policy Dialogues Support Facility (PDSF) aimed to facilitate and support the implementation of current and future EU-China Policy Dialogues. The project provided the European Commission and China with timely and skilled technical assistance and services to ensure the success of these dialogues.

ICON-INSTITUT played a key role in supporting the implementation of the EU-China Policy Dialogues to facilitate policy harmonization, shared best practices, and established platforms to enhance dialogue between China and the EU. ICON-INSTITUT also provided support to the European Commission and the Chinese government in managing the Policy Dialogues Support Facility (PDSF) through various services.

Key activities included conducting studies related to policy dialogues, organizing meetings, conferences, and seminars, and arranging field visits and study tours between China and the EU. These efforts contributed to fostering mutual understanding and cooperation across multiple sectors.
